{{dablink|For other uses of the words "white" and "mountain," see [[White]] and [[Mountain]].}}
The '''White Mountain''' is a sept of the [[Chareen]] [[Aiel]].{{ref/book|c|White Mountain||White Mountain Sept}}

When [[Rand al'Thor]] asks [[Aviendha]] what type of trouble could occur at [[Imre Stand]], she suggests it could be a raid for sheep or goats by the White Mountain or [[Jarra (sept)|Jarra]] septs of the [[Chareen]] clan. They are the two septs closest to Imre.{{ref/book|4|37}}
